statement: The oldid-pinned WiiBrew Extension Controllers identification section documents the Classic Controller Pro six-byte extension identification as 01 00 A4 20 01 01 at 0xA400FA, in contrast to the original Classic Controller's 00 00 A4 20 01 01. Their trailing two-byte type/format suffix is shared (0x0101), which explains why Linux and SDL suffix-only classifiers cannot distinguish the two. This is community protocol documentation, not a new physical capture. Related research records: wii-gap-classic-pro-host-classifier-tail captures the Linux/SDL suffix-only classification, while wii-gap-classic-pro-full-id-physical-unknown retains the unmeasured physical-identity gap despite this new documentary source.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew community documented Wii Remote family; precise physical hardware variant not independently captured
applicability.scope: WiiBrew Extension Controllers oldid 121955 Identification reports a full Classic Pro identity; corroborates the narrower host parsing in wii-gap-classic-pro-host-classifier-tail and supplies documentary support, but not a retail capture, for wii-gap-classic-pro-full-id-physical-unknown (which stays unknown). Compare pinned Linux hid-wiimote-core.c 431-450 and SDL_hidapi_wii.c 311-364. #19 is merged.
